content: Anthropic caching: prefix order tools->system->messages; max 4 breakpoints; ephemeral 5m default, ttl 1h option; top-level automatic cache_control places/moves breakpoint on last cacheable block and composes with explicit markers (robust agent-loop combo = explicit marker on last system block + top-level auto). Min cacheable prefix: 512 (Opus 5/5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Fable), 1024 (Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, Sonnet 4.6), 2048 (Opus 4.7), 4096 (Haiku 4.5, Opus 4.5/4.6). usage: input_tokens (uncached remainder), cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens. Forced tool_choice any/tool returns 400 on Opus 5.5/Sonnet 5.5/Fable 5.1 (use auto+strict). 20-block lookback.
